events.name: Bash
events.head: Check live mirror matches main hub
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/?v=t273f341$(date +%s)" -o /tmp/live273.html; grep -c "Two-Month Platform Pass" /tmp/live273.html; grep -c "1 month, worth" /tmp/live273.html; diff -q /tmp/live273.html workshop-plan/index.html && echo SAME; git show f341d58f:workshop-plan/index.html | diff -q - /tmp/live273.html && echo SAME_AS_F341; git branch -r --contains f341d58f | head -2; grep -n "Two-Month" app/src/lib/vip-kit.ts app/src/lib/funnel.ts 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect hub diffs since f341
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/index.html; git status --short workshop-plan/index.html; diff /tmp/live273.html workshop-plan/index.html | head -8; grep -rn "Two-Month" app/src/lib/*.ts | grep -v vip-kit | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find funnel wording and mirror head
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "Two-Month Platform Pass" app/src | head; cd /tmp && git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign ls-remote https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live.git HEAD 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-9
